craft_notes: Sthāyin: Rati for sight and stay (abhilāṣa) settling into praise. Capital→lower 'what' line 2 (ascent easing into wonder). Rejected: period after Lord — question kept open. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: What road unreached by him? What tongue unspeaking him?
what trance untaking him? What — what is he not, O Lord?
l4.sanskrit_cite: kaḥ panthā yena na prāpyaḥ kā ca vāṅ nocyase yayā kiṃ dhyānaṃ yena na dhyeyaḥ kiṃ vā kiṃ nāsi yat prabho

reads_against.argmap: What path by which unattainable? What speech by which unspoken? → Every path, word, and meditation reaches you; you are all.
c1_essence: Mantra refuge praised; every path, word, meditation is the Lord.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)

l2.plain_english: What path by which unattainable? What speech by which unspoken? What meditation by which unmeditated? What — what are you not, O Lord?
l2.sanskrit_cite: kaḥ panthā yena na prāpyaḥ kā ca vāṅ nocyase yayā kiṃ dhyānaṃ yena na dhyeyaḥ kiṃ vā kiṃ nāsi yat prabho

l3: What road unreached by him? What tongue unspeaking him?
What trance untaking him? What — what is he not, O Lord?
reads_against.t1: What path by which you are not attained, what speech by which you are not said, what meditation by which you are not meditated — or what are you not, O Lord?
